executive_summary.key_finding: The codebase is a well-structured pure-Python library with comprehensive domain logic but has zero production deployment infrastructure. All state is in-memory, no containerization exists, no CI/CD pipeline, no monitoring, and no horizontal scaling capability. It cannot be deployed as-is to any production environment.

gaps.title: All state is in-memory with no shared state backend
gaps.description: TenantRegistry, SwarmCoordinator, AlertManager, AgriKnowledgeGraph, AGROVOCOntology, and all other stateful components store data in Python dicts/lists. Multiple processes cannot share state.
gaps.impact: Cannot run multiple replicas. Any state is lost on restart. No horizontal scaling possible.
gaps.recommendation: Introduce Redis for shared state, or refactor to use external databases (PostgreSQL for relational, Redis for cache/sessions, Neo4j for graph). Add repository pattern for data access abstraction.

gaps.title: MQTT and Kafka clients are in-memory stubs
gaps.description: MQTTClient and KafkaStream use Python queues instead of real message brokers. No actual pub/sub or event streaming capability.
gaps.impact: No real-time data ingestion from IoT devices. No event-driven architecture. Cannot scale message processing.
gaps.recommendation: Integrate paho-mqtt for MQTT and kafka-python or confluent-kafka for Kafka. Add connection pooling, retry logic, and dead-letter queues.

gaps.title: TimescaleDB storage is in-memory stub
gaps.description: TimescaleDBStorage uses Python dicts instead of actual TimescaleDB. No real time-series data persistence.
gaps.impact: No time-series data persistence. No real analytics capability. Data lost on restart.
gaps.recommendation: Integrate psycopg2 or asyncpg for real TimescaleDB connectivity. Add connection pooling and migration support.

gaps.title: No distributed locking mechanism
gaps.description: SwarmCoordinator and other components use threading.Lock which only works within a single process.
gaps.impact: Race conditions in multi-replica deployments. Task double-assignment possible.
gaps.recommendation: Implement distributed locking with Redis (Redlock algorithm) or database-backed locks.

gaps.title: No load balancing or service discovery
gaps.description: No configuration for load balancers, service mesh, or service discovery.
gaps.impact: Cannot distribute traffic across multiple instances.
gaps.recommendation: Add Kubernetes Service manifests, consider Istio/Linkerd for service mesh, implement health-based load balancing.

gaps.title: No circuit breaker or bulkhead patterns
gaps.description: External service calls (NGSI-LD broker, ONNX models) have no circuit breaker, timeout cascade protection, or bulkhead isolation.
gaps.impact: Cascading failures when external services degrade. No graceful degradation.
gaps.recommendation: Implement circuit breaker pattern (e.g., pybreaker, tenacity). Add bulkhead isolation for different external service calls.

gaps.title: No request rate limiting at API gateway level
gaps.description: Rate limiting exists only in ZeroTrustAuth module but is not integrated into the FastAPI middleware stack.
gaps.impact: API can be overwhelmed by traffic spikes. No protection against abuse.
gaps.recommendation: Add slowapi or custom FastAPI middleware for rate limiting. Integrate with ZeroTrustAuth.

gaps.title: No caching layer
gaps.description: No Redis/Memcached integration for caching frequent queries, model inferences, or computation results.
gaps.impact: Repeated expensive computations (TSP/VRP solving, ONNX inference) cannot be cached.
gaps.recommendation: Add Redis caching for expensive operations. Implement cache-aside pattern for knowledge graph queries and optimization results.

gaps.title: No async I/O for external service calls
gaps.description: NGSI-LD broker uses synchronous requests library. ONNX inference is synchronous. Blocks the event loop.
gaps.impact: Poor throughput under concurrent load. Event loop blocking in FastAPI.
gaps.recommendation: Use httpx.AsyncClient for NGSI-LD. Consider async ONNX Runtime or run inference in thread pool.

gaps.title: No GPU resource management or scheduling
gaps.description: GPU TSP/VRP solvers use PyTorch CUDA but have no GPU memory management, no multi-GPU support, and no GPU sharing.
gaps.impact: Cannot share GPU across multiple inference requests. Potential OOM errors.
gaps.recommendation: Add GPU memory fraction limits, implement request queuing for GPU resources, consider CUDA streams for concurrent inference.

gaps.title: No Dockerfile
gaps.description: No container image build definition exists. Application cannot be containerized.
gaps.impact: Cannot deploy to any container orchestration platform.
gaps.recommendation: Create multi-stage Dockerfile: builder stage (install deps) + runtime stage (copy artifacts). Use python:3.11-slim base. Pin all dependencies.

gaps.title: No docker-compose.yml for local development
gaps.description: No local development environment with dependencies (Redis, TimescaleDB, MQTT broker, etc.).
gaps.impact: Developers cannot run the full stack locally. High barrier to contribution.
gaps.recommendation: Create docker-compose.yml with all required services: app, redis, timescaledb, mqtt (mosquitto), kafka, neo4j.

gaps.title: No .dockerignore
gaps.description: No .dockerignore file. Build context may include unnecessary files.
gaps.impact: Larger build context, slower builds, potential secret leakage.
gaps.recommendation: Create .dockerignore excluding: .git, __pycache__, *.pyc, .pytest_cache, htmlcov, .env, *.onnx, tests/

gaps.title: No health check endpoints for containers
gaps.description: Only basic /health endpoint exists. No /ready or /live endpoints for Kubernetes probes.
gaps.impact: Cannot configure proper Kubernetes liveness/readiness probes.
gaps.recommendation: Add /healthz (liveness), /readyz (readiness with dependency checks), and /metrics (Prometheus) endpoints.

gaps.title: No dependency management files
gaps.description: No requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, or setup.py. Dependencies are only mentioned in README.
gaps.impact: Cannot reproduce builds. No dependency pinning. Security vulnerabilities from unpinned deps.
gaps.recommendation: Create pyproject.toml with all dependencies pinned. Add requirements.txt for container builds. Use pip-tools or poetry for lock files.

gaps.title: No multi-stage build optimization
gaps.description: No optimized container build strategy.
gaps.impact: Larger images, slower deployments.
gaps.recommendation: Use multi-stage builds: compile stage with build tools, runtime stage with only runtime deps. Target <200MB image.

gaps.title: No container security hardening
gaps.description: No non-root user, no read-only filesystem, no security scanning.
gaps.impact: Security vulnerabilities in container runtime.
gaps.recommendation: Run as non-root user, enable read-only root filesystem, scan images with Trivy/Snyk, use distroless base image.

gaps.title: No Deployment manifests
gaps.description: No Kubernetes Deployment YAML for any component.
gaps.impact: Cannot deploy to Kubernetes.
gaps.recommendation: Create Deployment manifests for: api-gateway, dashboard, optimization-worker, iot-pipeline, decision-support. Include resource requests/limits, replica counts, and rolling update strategy.

gaps.title: No Service manifests
gaps.description: No Kubernetes Service definitions for internal/external communication.
gaps.impact: No service discovery or load balancing.
gaps.recommendation: Create ClusterIP services for internal communication, LoadBalancer/NodePort for external access. Add Ingress for HTTP routing.

gaps.title: No ConfigMap or Secret management
gaps.description: No configuration externalization. Secrets (JWT secret, DB passwords) would be hardcoded.
gaps.impact: Configuration cannot be changed without redeployment. Secrets exposed in code.
gaps.recommendation: Create ConfigMaps for non-sensitive config (timeouts, thresholds, feature flags). Use Kubernetes Secrets or external secret management (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager) for credentials.

gaps.title: No Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA)
gaps.description: No autoscaling configuration.
gaps.impact: Cannot scale based on CPU/memory/custom metrics.
gaps.recommendation: Create HPA for each deployment. Use CPU/memory for general scaling, custom metrics (queue depth, request latency) for pipeline workers.

gaps.title: No Ingress configuration
gaps.description: No HTTP routing, TLS termination, or domain configuration.
gaps.impact: No external access to services.
gaps.recommendation: Create Ingress with cert-manager for TLS. Route /api/* to api-gateway, /ws/* to dashboard, /metrics to monitoring.

gaps.title: No PodDisruptionBudget
gaps.description: No availability guarantees during voluntary disruptions.
gaps.impact: Service unavailable during node drains or cluster upgrades.
gaps.recommendation: Create PodDisruptionBudget with minAvailable: 1 for single-replica services, minAvailable: 2 for multi-replica services.

gaps.title: No NetworkPolicy
gaps.description: No network segmentation between services.
gaps.impact: Any pod can communicate with any other pod. Security risk.
gaps.recommendation: Create NetworkPolicies: api-gateway can only talk to backend services, iot-pipeline can only talk to message brokers, database only accessible by backend services.

gaps.title: No StatefulSet for stateful components
gaps.description: No StatefulSet for TimescaleDB, Redis, or other stateful services.
gaps.impact: Stateful services cannot be properly managed.
gaps.recommendation: Use StatefulSet with PersistentVolumeClaims for TimescaleDB, Redis, Neo4j. Consider managed services instead.

gaps.title: No resource requests or limits
gaps.description: No CPU/memory resource specifications.
gaps.impact: No resource guarantees. Potential OOM kills. No scheduling optimization.
gaps.recommendation: Set resource requests based on profiling: api-gateway (500m CPU, 512Mi), optimization-worker (2000m CPU, 4Gi for GPU), iot-pipeline (1000m CPU, 1Gi).

gaps.title: No GPU node scheduling configuration
gaps.description: No node affinity/tolerations for GPU workloads.
gaps.impact: GPU workloads may schedule on non-GPU nodes.
gaps.recommendation: Add nodeSelector for GPU nodes, use nvidia.com/gpu resource limits, add tolerations for GPU node taints.

gaps.title: No Helm chart or Kustomize configuration
gaps.description: No templated deployment configuration.
gaps.impact: Cannot easily deploy to different environments (dev/staging/prod).
gaps.recommendation: Create Helm chart with values.yaml for each environment. Use Kustomize for environment-specific overlays.

gaps.title: No service mesh configuration
gaps.description: No Istio/Linkerd configuration for mTLS, traffic management, or observability.
gaps.impact: No fine-grained traffic control or mutual TLS.
gaps.recommendation: Consider Istio for mTLS, traffic splitting, and observability. Start with sidecar injection and mTLS.

gaps.title: No GitHub Actions workflows
gaps.description: No CI/CD automation. No automated testing, building, or deployment.
gaps.impact: No quality gate. Manual testing and deployment only.
gaps.recommendation: Create .github/workflows/ci.yml: lint (ruff/black), type-check (mypy), test (pytest with coverage), security-scan (bandit, safety), build (docker image).

gaps.title: No automated testing pipeline
gaps.description: Tests exist but are not run automatically on push/PR.
gaps.impact: Regressions not caught early. No quality assurance.
gaps.recommendation: Run pytest on every push. Enforce 80%+ coverage. Add integration tests with testcontainers.

gaps.title: No linting or formatting checks
gaps.description: No code quality enforcement.
gaps.impact: Inconsistent code style. Potential bugs not caught.
gaps.recommendation: Add ruff for linting, black for formatting, isort for import sorting. Run in CI with --check flag.

gaps.title: No type checking
gaps.description: No static type checking despite type hints in code.
gaps.impact: Type errors not caught until runtime.
gaps.recommendation: Add mypy to CI. Start with strict mode for new code, gradually increase coverage.

gaps.title: No security scanning
gaps.description: No SAST, dependency vulnerability scanning, or secret detection.
gaps.impact: Security vulnerabilities not detected. Secrets may be committed.
gaps.recommendation: Add bandit (SAST), safety/pip-audit (dependency scanning), gitleaks (secret detection), trivy (container scanning).

gaps.title: No container image building in CI
gaps.description: No automated Docker image builds.
gaps.impact: Manual image builds. No image versioning.
gaps.recommendation: Build and push container images on every merge to main. Tag with git SHA and semantic version.

gaps.title: No deployment automation
gaps.description: No CD pipeline for deploying to environments.
gaps.impact: Manual deployments. Error-prone.
gaps.recommendation: Create CD workflow: deploy to staging on merge to main, deploy to prod on tag. Use Helm or kubectl.

gaps.title: No database migration automation
gaps.description: No schema migration tooling.
gaps.impact: Manual schema changes. Potential data loss.
gaps.recommendation: Add Alembic for database migrations. Run migrations in CI against test database.

gaps.title: No release automation
gaps.description: No automated versioning or changelog generation.
gaps.impact: Manual release process. Inconsistent versioning.
gaps.recommendation: Use semantic-release or release-please for automated versioning. Generate changelog from conventional commits.

gaps.title: No performance regression testing
gaps.description: No automated performance benchmarks in CI.
gaps.impact: Performance regressions not detected.
gaps.recommendation: Add pytest-benchmark for performance tests. Set thresholds and fail CI on regression.

gaps.title: No Prometheus metrics
gaps.description: No metrics endpoint. No application metrics exposed.
gaps.impact: Cannot monitor request rate, error rate, latency, or resource usage.
gaps.recommendation: Add prometheus-client. Expose /metrics endpoint. Track: request_count, request_duration_seconds, error_count, active_connections, task_queue_depth, inference_latency.

gaps.title: No structured logging
gaps.description: Basic Python logging with no structured format. No correlation IDs.
gaps.impact: Cannot trace requests across services. Difficult to debug production issues.
gaps.recommendation: Use structlog or python-json-logger for JSON structured logging. Add trace_id, span_id, request_id to all log entries.

gaps.title: No distributed tracing
gaps.description: No OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, or Zipkin integration.
gaps.impact: Cannot trace requests across microservices. Cannot identify latency bottlenecks.
gaps.recommendation: Add OpenTelemetry SDK. Instrument FastAPI, PyTorch inference, and external HTTP calls. Export to Jaeger or Tempo.

gaps.title: No Grafana dashboards
gaps.description: No visualization of metrics.
gaps.impact: Cannot visualize system health or performance.
gaps.recommendation: Create Grafana dashboards: API latency/throughput, error rates, resource utilization, business metrics (tasks completed, alerts triggered).

gaps.title: No alerting rules
gaps.description: No Prometheus alerting rules or notification channels.
gaps.impact: Issues not detected until users report them.
gaps.recommendation: Create alerting rules: high error rate (>5%), high latency (p99 > 1s), high memory usage (>80%), service down. Route to PagerDuty/Slack.

gaps.title: No health check probes
gaps.description: Only basic /health endpoint. No readiness or liveness probes.
gaps.impact: Cannot properly configure Kubernetes probes. Traffic may be sent to unhealthy pods.
gaps.recommendation: Add /healthz (liveness - process alive), /readyz (readiness - dependencies healthy), /startup (startup complete).

gaps.title: No log aggregation
gaps.description: No centralized logging (ELK, Loki, CloudWatch).
gaps.impact: Logs lost when pods restart. Cannot search across services.
gaps.recommendation: Deploy Fluent Bit or Promtail as DaemonSet. Aggregate to Elasticsearch/Loki. Set up log retention policies.

gaps.title: No SLO/SLA definitions
gaps.description: No service level objectives or agreements.
gaps.impact: No clear reliability targets. Cannot measure user experience.
gaps.recommendation: Define SLOs: 99.9% availability, p99 latency < 500ms, error rate < 0.1%. Create error budgets.

gaps.title: No APM integration
gaps.description: No application performance monitoring (Datadog, New Relic, etc.).
gaps.impact: No code-level performance insights.
gaps.recommendation: Consider APM tool for production. OpenTelemetry can export to multiple backends.

gaps.title: No business metrics tracking
gaps.description: No tracking of business KPIs (tasks completed, farms monitored, alerts resolved).
gaps.impact: Cannot measure business impact or feature usage.
gaps.recommendation: Add business metrics: tasks_completed_total, farms_active, alerts_triggered_total, recommendations_generated_total.

gaps.title: No package installation support
gaps.description: No pyproject.toml, setup.py, or setup.cfg. Cannot be installed as a Python package.
gaps.impact: Cannot be distributed or installed. Import paths assume running from repo root.
gaps.recommendation: Create pyproject.toml with setuptools or poetry backend. Define package metadata, dependencies, and entry points.

gaps.title: No environment configuration management
gaps.description: No .env.example, no configuration files, no environment variable documentation.
gaps.impact: Configuration is hardcoded. Cannot deploy to different environments.
gaps.recommendation: Create config.yaml or .env.example. Use pydantic-settings for typed configuration. Document all environment variables.

gaps.title: No API versioning strategy
gaps.description: API version is hardcoded as v1 in URL path. No versioning policy.
gaps.impact: Breaking changes cannot be managed.
gaps.recommendation: Implement API versioning strategy (URL path or header). Document deprecation policy.

gaps.title: No CORS configuration
gaps.description: No CORS middleware in FastAPI applications.
gaps.impact: Web clients cannot access API from different origins.
gaps.recommendation: Add CORSMiddleware with configurable allowed origins.

gaps.title: No request validation middleware
gaps.description: No global request validation or sanitization.
gaps.impact: Invalid data may cause unexpected errors.
gaps.recommendation: Add Pydantic models for all request/response. Add global exception handlers.

gaps.title: No database migration strategy
gaps.description: No schema versioning or migration tooling.
gaps.impact: Schema changes are manual and error-prone.
gaps.recommendation: Add Alembic for SQL databases. Version control all schema changes.

gaps.title: No backup and restore strategy
gaps.description: No data backup or disaster recovery plan.
gaps.impact: Data loss on failure. No recovery capability.
gaps.recommendation: Implement automated backups for all persistent data. Test restore procedures regularly.

gaps.title: No multi-region deployment support
gaps.description: No configuration for multi-region or edge deployment.
gaps.impact: Cannot deploy to multiple regions for latency or compliance.
gaps.recommendation: Design for multi-region: data replication, region-aware routing, conflict resolution.

gaps.title: No WebSocket scaling strategy
gaps.description: Dashboard WebSocket connections are in-memory. Cannot scale horizontally.
gaps.impact: WebSocket connections limited to single instance.
gaps.recommendation: Use Redis Pub/Sub for WebSocket message broadcasting across instances.

gaps.title: No OpenAPI documentation customization
gaps.description: FastAPI auto-generates OpenAPI docs but no customization.
gaps.impact: API documentation is generic and not user-friendly.
gaps.recommendation: Customize OpenAPI schema with descriptions, examples, and tags.

immediate: Create Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml for local development
Implement Redis-backed shared state for TenantRegistry and SwarmCoordinator
Create GitHub Actions CI workflow with linting, testing, and security scanning
Create basic Kubernetes Deployment and Service manifests

Add structured logging with trace IDs
Set up Grafana dashboards and alerting
medium_term: Implement circuit breakers and bulkhead patterns
Create CD pipeline with automated deployments
